title: let read-only roles run `slicer check --help` the way they can run `slicer check`, or put the command's read-only note in the brief

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261119-145438-e916, project ork, item S470:

let read-only roles run `slicer check --help` the way they can run `slicer check`, or put the command's read-only note in the brief

Evidence: I needed `slicer check --help` to confirm the command writes nothing before accepting it on a read-only list; it ran here, but S469 shows other `--help` calls are not allowed for read-only roles.
